title: Baseline record
description: One patient at the start of a systemic therapy line. One record per patient.

tumour_type.title: Tumour type
tumour_type.description: Primary tumour. All patients have advanced disease.

regimen.title: Regimen
regimen.description: Systemic therapy that starts on day 1.

ecog.title: ECOG
ecog.description: ECOG performance status at therapy start.

ga_impaired_domains.title: Impaired geriatric domains
ga_impaired_domains.description: Number of impaired domains in a geriatric assessment (physical function, cognition, emotional health, comorbidity, polypharmacy, nutrition, social support). Null if no assessment was done.

spo2_percent.title: Oxygen saturation
spo2_percent.description: Oxygen saturation at rest at therapy start.

lung_comorbidity.title: Lung comorbidity
lung_comorbidity.description: Asthma, COPD, earlier interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, emphysema or radiation pneumonitis.

years_since_diagnosis.title: Years since diagnosis
years_since_diagnosis.description: Time from first cancer diagnosis to therapy start.
